ai_summary.text:
アイルは中堅・中小企業向けの販売管理・在庫管理システムと、ECサイト構築プラットフォームを提供するIT企業。自社開発のERP「アラジンオフィス」とECサイト構築「アラジンEC」を二本柱に、製造業・卸売業の業務効率化を支援している。

売上193億円（前年比+10.2%）と二桁増収。営業利益48億円（営業利益率25%）、純利益35億円。パッケージソフトとECプラットフォームのサブスクリプション収入で25%の営業利益率を実現しており、中堅企業のDX投資拡大が業績を押し上げた。ROE30.9%と極めて高い資本効率。

自己資本比率71.6%、財務健全性スコア100点と完璧な財務。営業CF34億円、FCF28億円とほぼ全額がFCFとして残る。EPS141円に対しPER20倍、配当50円で配当性向は約35%。中堅・中小企業のDX化は浸透率が低く成長余地が大きい。なお、EPS141.3円、PER20.0倍、1株当たり配当金50.0円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: AILL is an IT company that provides sales and inventory management systems for medium-sized and small businesses, and an EC site construction platform. With its own ERP "Aladdin Office" and EC site construction "Aladdin EC" as its two main pillars, it supports the operational efficiency of manufacturers and wholesalers.  Double-digit revenue growth with sales of  19.3 billion (up 10.2% year-on-year). Operating profit of  4.8 billion (operating profit margin of 25%) and net profit of  3.5 billion. Achieved an operating profit margin of 25% with subscription revenue from package software and EC platforms, and the expansion of DX investment by medium-sized companies boosted performance. Extremely high capital efficiency with an ROE of 30.9%.  Perfect finances with an equity ratio of 71.6% and a financial soundness score of 100. Operating CF of  3.4 billion and FCF of  2.8 billion, with almost the entire amount remaining as FCF. PER of 20 against EPS of  141, and a dividend payout ratio of approximately 35% with a dividend of  50. The penetration rate of DX in medium-sized and small businesses is low, and there is significant room for growth. Furthermore, with EPS at  141.3, PER at 20.0, and dividends per share at  50.0, the company is promoting management that balances shareholder returns and corporate value enhancement.
